name: Government House, Brisbane
scope: Whole connected Government House/Fernberg mansion exterior:1888 north Italianate reception block/faceted bays/square open-loggia tower, original1865 southern guest wing/raised slate hip and paired-arch clerestory, connected1937 eastern wing, surviving verandahs/balconies/semicircular piazza ends, bounded1950 western covered connection/porte cochere and rear court. Exclude separate estate residences/administration cottage/garages/guardhouse, grounds/gates/fountain/pool/vegetation, interiors, exact stained-glass figures/crests and flags.
era: Surviving mansion with1865/1888/1937 and connected1950 exterior, native2025 footprint; current2022 creatorCC0 and2005 creatorPD exterior, government circa1940 plans used only for intrinsic topology.

references.caption:
Queensland Government House at Bardon
( this photograph was taken by Figaro )

originalReview.notes: Individually inspected exact700x650 Figaro2005 native original, own work/transferred named PD-user-w release. North/west1888 mansion corner: white stucco/rusticated quoins, two storeys/cornices, segmental-headed sash openings, faceted bays with awning-covered balcony recesses/balusters, prominent square tower/open upper loggia/shallow pyramidal roof, lower open veranda with paired slender columns. Trees/people/flags/figured reliefs excluded.

originalReview.notes: Individually inspected exact4112x3088 John Robert McPherson2022 own-work/self-CC0 native original. Opposite side: two-storey tower-front block has balustraded roof parapet/bracketed cornice, tall sash openings and narrow faceted bay; original southern wing has dark slate hip roof and raised paired-arched clerestory/dormer. Current flat covered connection/porte cochere uses broad fascia/slender supports. Bright tower lamp clips fine top detail; use clearer2005 daylight for open loggia. Cars/people/trees/flags and copied stained-glass figures excluded.

Six exact originals individually inspected: four surviving-exterior photographs with direct named FigaroPD-user or McPhersonselfCC0 grants, two native QueenslandStateArchives public-domain government plans. Public-domain status of plans is explicit government-work/expired Crown record, not an unknown-photographer guess. No questionable source adopted, no supplemental imagery fetch/generated bitmap/borrowed mesh; native map and official heritage text support architecture. No source article/media metadata repair.
